Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Role: Co-host of Vibe Rant; teacher of occult symbolism & tarot

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Demonia and the Ark Goddess", "body": "Chance introduced the Greek idea of demonia, which he said meant the souls of the dead and not evil spirits, and he stressed that he was entertaining it as an idea rather than claiming it was true. He described the ancients' belief in a holding space for the dead, such as Pandora's box or the ark, until the world was renewed. He tied the notion to Argo, the ark as goddess, boat, and womb, and read Rihanna's name as a link to the queen of heaven, Rhea."}, {"title": "The Super Bowl as Ritual Theater", "body": "The hosts spent much of the night reading the Super Bowl as ritual theater. One of the hosts walked through a halftime graphic and argued that the dancers, the navel imagery, a makeup moment, and a white and black color scheme carried hidden symbolism. Chance, who watched with his family, took a page of notes and pointed to an avocado ad about Adam and Eve and an antivirus ad built on the Trojan horse, calling the night an Iliad. He added that he did not necessarily believe any sacrifice was involved, and wondered whether the logos was simply speaking through synchronicity."}, {"title": "Gabe's Enneagram Lens on Events", "body": "Gabe applied his Enneagram project to the news and to literature. He said he had matched figures on the world stage to personality types and argued that the presidential lineage followed the types in sequence. He placed Aristophanes as a number four whose comedy pointed toward the fool at number one, and he read the nine day fall in Milton's Paradise Lost as a nod to slothful number nine. Gabe also suggested Milton may have known the Enneagram and tried to scramble it, and he showed a territories map with a 180 degree axis between Arizona and the Ohio area."}, {"title": "Training, Shelter in Place, and HB 1333", "body": "One of the hosts read Webster's 1828 definitions of the word train and argued that it described a stratagem of enticement, noting that conspiracy circles watch for training exercises alongside major events. Gordy described a chemical spill near Tucson that triggered a shelter in place alert, and he argued that it looked like practice for future climate lockdowns. Chance reported that his search for HB 1333 turned up a Missouri arson bill. One of the hosts voiced concern that a proposed ministry of truth could chill open questions about history."}, {"title": "Owls, Breath, and Releasing Tension", "body": "Gordy shared photos and video of nesting owls and a bobcat encounter, which he described as having shamanic initiation overtones, and he joked about the spiritual two by four. He later led a short breathing and humming exercise, urging listeners to let go of the noise of the news. Chance added a Biofield Tuning pointer, directing listeners to the left shoulder and armpit area as a place where the biofield absorbs the suffering of others, and said a symbolic action can help people move on. He closed by noting strong demand for one on one tunings."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Tonight we'll further explore the secret seeds of the enneagram contained in ancient philosophers, media theater, and the pandemonium of recent world events, with our resident syncromythical symbol sleuth, Slick Dissident.
